summary.name: Core Tunnel
summary.one_liner: Core Tunnel is a macOS app for creating, managing and monitoring SSH tunnels and port forwards that is compatible with OpenSSH configuration.
use_cases: Managing many SSH tunnels from one place
Setting up local, remote or dynamic port forwarding
Keeping SSH tunnels alive after network drops or sleep
Storing SSH key passphrases in macOS Keychain
Organizing large numbers of tunnels with tags
summary.what_it_does: Core Tunnel connects to and monitors SSH tunnels, supporting local, remote and dynamic port forwarding, agent forwarding, certificates and ProxyJump, as described on the page. It integrates with the macOS Keychain to store passphrases. It has an advanced options editor with contextual help for SSH directives. It attempts to restore connections after network failure or waking from sleep, and offers a menu bar status icon for controlling tunnels without switching windows.
notable: Tight integration with macOS Keychain for passphrases
Automatic reconnect after network failure or sleep
caveats: Free Basic tier is limited to 1 host
Premium price starts at $9.99 (billing period not stated)
Automatic syncing, import/export and custom tags are listed in the premium comparison table; the table does not clearly state which of these are free
